## Argument groups

### Inputs

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--genome_fasta`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Reference genome file in FASTA or FASTA.GZ format. The BD Rhapsody Sequencing Analysis Pipeline uses GRCh38 for Human and GRCm39 for Mouse.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"genome_sequence.fa.gz"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--gtf`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
File path to the transcript annotation files in GTF or GTF.GZ format. The Sequence Analysis Pipeline requires the 'gene_name' or
'gene_id' attribute to be set on each gene and exon feature. Gene and exon feature lines must have the same attribute, and exons
must have a corresponding gene with the same value. For TCR/BCR assays, the TCR or BCR gene segments must have the 'gene_type' or
'gene_biotype' attribute set, and the value should begin with 'TR' or 'IG', respectively.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"transcriptome_annotation.gtf.gz"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--extra_sequences`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
File path to additional sequences in FASTA format to use when building the STAR index. (e.g. transgenes or CRISPR guide barcodes).
GTF lines for these sequences will be automatically generated and combined with the main GTF.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"extra_sequence_1.fa.gz"`, `"extra_sequence_2.fa.gz"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::::

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name

Attributes

::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--mitochondrial_contigs`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Names of the Mitochondrial contigs in the provided Reference Genome. Fragments originating from contigs other than these are
identified as 'nuclear fragments' in the ATACseq analysis pipeline.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"chrM"`, `"chrMT"`, `"M"`, `"MT"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--filtering_off`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
By default the input Transcript Annotation files are filtered based on the gene_type/gene_biotype attribute. Only features
having the following attribute values are kept:

  - protein_coding
  - lncRNA
  - IG_LV_gene
  - IG_V_gene
  - IG_V_pseudogene
  - IG_D_gene
  - IG_J_gene
  - IG_J_pseudogene
  - IG_C_gene
  - IG_C_pseudogene
  - TR_V_gene
  - TR_V_pseudogene
  - TR_D_gene
  - TR_J_gene
  - TR_J_pseudogene
  - TR_C_gene

  If you have already pre-filtered the input Annotation files and/or wish to turn-off the filtering, please set this option to True.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--wta_only_index`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Build a WTA only index, otherwise builds a WTA + ATAC index.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--extra_star_params`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Additional parameters to pass to STAR when building the genome index. Specify exactly like how you would on the command line.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"--limitGenomeGenerateRAM 48000 --genomeSAindexNbases 11"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/reference/build_bdrhap_reference/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/reference/build_bdrhap_reference);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/reference/build_bdrhap_reference/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
